title: Argentinian Beef Empanadas
description: A classic Argentinian dish made with tender beef and crispy pastry. Perfect for a snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: Empanada Pastry
ingredients.notes: Make sure to thaw the pastry before using

instructions: In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the ground beef to the pan, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Once the beef is browned, add the breadcrumbs, egg, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Roll out the empanada pastry and cut out circles of dough, about 5 inches (13 cm) in diameter.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture in the center of each dough circle. Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of water and use a fork to crimp the edges.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush the tops with a little bit of oil.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve the empanadas hot with a side of yummy chimichurri sauce, if desired.
